h1: Custom 6 oz Products for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 6 oz products in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for samples, giveaways, and travel-sized promotions.
introHtml: Six-ounce products are a versatile choice for bulk buyers who need compact, portable items for giveaways, sample promotions, or event swag. From lip balms and hand sanitizers to mini water bottles, this size is easy to distribute and fits in pockets or small bags. Decorate with screen printing, pad printing, or labels to showcase your logo effectively.
heroAltText: Assorted custom 6 oz products including mini bottles and tins with logos, perfect for promotional giveaways
